task: CE PoC — destroy_infrastructure causal chain (2 vitest failures caught by the design's own test gate)
error: 2 of 6 tests failed: (1) tradeVolume expected 0, got 8 after destroying grain_road; (2) RF grain price expected > 15, got 10.13.
rootCause: Design decision modeled infrastructure as per-region copies (grain_road stored on both endpoint regions RF and HT). The destroy_infrastructure schema's immediateEffects only zeroed the copy in the intervention's location region (RF), while the trade loop reads the exporter copy (HT), which stayed at health 1.0 — trade continued and prices never rose.
whatActuallyHappened: The verification gate (vitest suite designed before implementation) caught the defect. Root cause traced to inconsistent identity semantics: per-region infrastructure copies vs world-global structure identity.
mitigation: Fixed immediateEffects to zero every copy of the structure across all regions (a structure is a single world object; per-region copies are references). All 6 tests then passed. Design lesson recorded: infrastructure identity must be world-global in the destroy semantics even when state is partitioned per region.
